r7-pe-invariance.title: PE-invariance round-trip
r7-pe-invariance.imperative: Verify in code: E_total=1/2mv^2+mgz; dE/ds=F_vehicle; a_long=F/m-g sin(theta). Confirm gravity added into force then removed on output so a_long round-trips to actual on-track accel, independent of PE term; terrain payoff lives in F_vehicle. Record pass/fail.
r7-pe-invariance.finding: VERIFIED & CORRECT. Code: e_obs=0.5*m*v^2+m*g*z (L405); f_soft=m*(a_tv+g*sin0) (L406); a_long=f_vehicle/m - g*sin0 (L423). Math: dE/ds = m*v*dv/ds + m*g*dz/ds = m*a + m*g*sin0 = F_vehicle (since v*dv/ds=a, dz/ds=sin0). Independent round-trip on synthetic hill at grades 0/+4/+8/-6 deg: output identity residual a_long-(F/m - g*sin0) = 0.0e+00 EXACTLY; max|a_flat - a_terr| <= 0.08 (tiny, second-order v_rep coupling only); F_shift/m grows as g*sin0 (0.71@4deg,1.41@8deg). a_long genuinely blind to PE; terrain payoff lives in F_vehicle. Consistent across all grades, NOT a one-circuit coincidence.
